verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU bulijjo nkwetaaga,
Tondeka bw'omu;
Beera nange ggwe okumoi,
So tonvaamu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Bwe mba nsanyuka nkugamba
ebinsanyusa;
Era-ombeere okukola,
Ky'oyagala.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bwe mba ndaba-ennaku nnyingi
Ezintengezza;
Ggwe-ozimanyi ggwe Mukama
N'onsaasira

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Bwe mba nsobya ku ggwe Yesu
Olw'obunafu;
Nsaasira-obunafu bwange
Ompe-amaanyi.
